summary: Smoke-tested VeloSummit backend and frontend end-to-end via public preview URL. All 8 backend endpoints (famous-cols, summits CRUD, missing-cols, stats, upload, photos) return correct data. Frontend renders all 5 tabs with correct data-testids; Map shows Leaflet+Esri tiles with 15 markers and filter buttons; Add Summit dialog creates a summit that appears in list, updates stats & ascended pill; delete via confirm-delete works; Stats KPIs, Everest progress, and 3 Recharts render; Famous Cols catalog shows 14 quicklog buttons (1 already conquered); Missing Matrix shows 14 cols matching backend.
passed: GET /api/famous-cols returns 15 curated cols (first: Col du Galibier 2642m)
POST /api/summits creates summit with all fields, returns id
PUT /api/summits/{id} updates and returns updated payload
GET /api/missing-cols excludes cols with matching famous_col_id (count=14 after creating galibier summit)
GET /api/stats returns total_summits, total_elevation_m, total_distance_km, highest_peak, everests_climbed, by_month, by_year correctly computed
POST /api/upload accepts PNG multipart, returns path starting with 'velosummit/photos/'
GET /api/photos/{path} returns image bytes with content-type image/png
Frontend loads with header (VELO.SUMMIT logo, 5 nav tabs, ascended pill, log-summit-btn)
Map tab renders Leaflet .leaflet-container with 18 tiles loaded and all 3 map-filter buttons
Add Summit dialog opens, has famous-col-select, save-summit-btn; new summit persists and updates ascended pill (2642 -> 3876 m)
My Summits tab shows 2 summit cards after add; delete flow triggers confirm-delete AlertDialog and removes card
Stats tab shows stat-total-summits, stat-total-elevation, stat-total-distance, stat-highest, everest-progress, chart-cumulative, chart-per-month, chart-per-year
Famous Cols tab has catalog-search and 14 quicklog-* buttons (1 already conquered)
Missing Matrix tab renders 14 cols grouped by category matching backend

failed.issue: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby causes Radix warning in console

action_items: Optional: Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to AddSummitDialog to silence Radix a11y warning (non-blocking).
